title: Oozy Buttery French Apricot Madeleine
description: Buttery and dense French madeleines infused with apricot and a hint of kombu, perfect for a weeknight dessert. These madeleines are made with Mediterranean-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large mixing bowl, cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, making sure each egg is fully incorporated before adding the next.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, and salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and mix until just combined.
Stir in the chopped apricot and kombu cold extract.
Add the milk and mix until the batter is smooth.
Pour the batter into a madeleine pan and bake for 12-15 minutes, or until the edges are golden brown.
Remove the madeleines from the oven and let them cool in the pan for 5 minutes.
Transfer the madeleines to a wire rack to cool completely.
